_notes.title: Required. The tank's name, shown on the plate in the corner and as the page title. Up to 40 characters.
_notes.theme: Required. One of reef (white sand, coral, tropical fish), river (driftwood, ferns, tetras, and koi), or deep (dark water, vents, and fish that glow).
_notes.startingFish: Optional. From 1 to 6 fish names from the chosen tank. reef: Clownfish, Blue tang, Green chromis, Royal gramma, Yellow tang, Moorish idol. river: Neon tetra, Harlequin rasbora, Zebra danio, Angelfish, Pearl gourami, Koi. deep: Lanternfish, Hatchetfish, Flashlight fish, Dragonfish, Anglerfish. Schooling kinds arrive as a school. Default: Clownfish, Blue tang, and Green chromis on the reef; Neon tetra, Angelfish, and Koi on the river; Lanternfish, Hatchetfish, and Anglerfish in the deep.
_notes.cycleMinutes: Optional. How many real minutes one day in the tank lasts, from 5 to 1440. Each visitor can change it in Settings. Default: 60.
_notes.pearlRate: Optional. One of calm, normal, or fast: how quickly fish drop pearls. Default: normal.
_notes.sound: Optional. true or false: whether the water, the food, and the pearls make sound when the tank opens. Each visitor can switch it in Settings. Default: true.
